info.long_name: Percentage of Outpatient Visits for COVID-Related Symptoms
info.short_description: Estimated percentage of outpatient doctor visits with COVID-associated diagnoses, based on claims data from health system partners, as of the week-ending Saturday
info.long_description: This data source is based on information about outpatient visits, provided to CMU/Delphi by health system partners. Using this outpatient data, CMU/Delphi estimates the percentage of COVID-related doctor's visits in a given location, on a given day. Percent of all unique outpatient visits with primary ICD-10 code of any of: U071, U072, B9729, J1281, Z03818, B342, J1289. Delphi publishes daily values that are already smoothed over a 7-day window, so the value reported on each week-ending Saturday is taken as the weekly figure without further averaging
info.unit: Percent of outpatient visits, 7-day average ending Saturday

delphi_doctor_visits.name: CMU Delphi Epidata - Outpatient Claims
delphi_doctor_visits.organization: Carnegie Mellon University Delphi Research Group
delphi_doctor_visits.description: The Delphi outpatient claims signal estimates the percentage of outpatient doctor visits with COVID-19 diagnoses based on claims data from health system partners. CMU Delphi receives de-identified medical insurance claims data covering a significant fraction of United States healthcare visits. The signal tracks outpatient visits with COVID-related ICD-10 diagnosis codes (U071, U072, B9729, J1281, Z03818, B342, J1289). This signal provides near-real-time insight into COVID-19 activity at the community level based on actual healthcare encounters. Data are published as daily values at national, state, and county levels with approximately 3-4 day lag from the date of service. Those daily values are already smoothed over a trailing 7-day window (they show no weekday profile and a lag-1 autocorrelation of 0.998), so PopHIVE keeps the value reported on each week-ending Saturday rather than averaging the week a second time. This signal replaces the retired COVIDcast doctor-visits signal (smoothed_cli), which was smoothed with a Gaussian linear smoother.
delphi_doctor_visits.restrictions: CC-BY Attribution license. Data may be used with attribution to the CMU Delphi Group.
